title: A completed part sale with an inactive part keeps its totals
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two active parts for this test, part A with Sell Price $20.00 and part B with Sell Price $15.00.
  • Create a part sale for this test, part sale A, that sold 2 of part A and 1 of part B and is invoiced.
  • Set part A inactive after the invoice was made.
  • Start on part sale A's Parts tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part sale A's invoice Summary still reads Parts $55.00 (2 × $20.00 for part A + 1 × $15.00 for part B), and part A is still listed on it at $40.00: retiring it changed nothing on the sale.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-E1: “A line that already holds a part when the part becomes inactive stays on its work order, estimate or part sale, including a completed part sale, and its totals keep calculating.”
